notes.title: Version R.2.1 Is Now Live
notes.notes:
Greetings pilots

This version includes a number of tweaks and improvements. Details follow.

The ship's propulsion has been upgraded. The ship now thrusts slightly better and propellant consumption is slightly reduced. To compensate, damage to the engines now causes a more significant reduction in acceleration.

The audio warnings for low fuel and low hull now stop after 10 seconds. They start playing again whenever your ship takes more damage or consumes fuel again.

The Obstacle Course mission is now easier to complete and flows better. The requirement for Bronze medal is now simply to complete the course (time is not an issue). The Silver, Gold and Ace medals have had their requirements slightly relaxed. The final part of the course have been reworked to make the experience more satisfying.

Missile trails in the Point Defense scenario have been significantly reworked. They are now better looking and consume far less resources. The time between enemy missile attacks has been increased and a few bugs have been hopefully fixed.

The Assault mission is now slightly easier to complete for Bronze.

The overall intent was to fix obvious problems and reduce the difficulty for Bronze medals, while preserving the game's unique flight experience.

Good luck and good hunting!
The dev

notes.title: Update to Version R.2.0 Is Now Live
notes.notes:
Greetings, pilots

This update brings reworked gun gameplay, reworked cockpit visuals and several other updates and fixes. Details follow.

Guns are now easier and less frustrating to use. Instead of requiring reload after a set number of rounds, guns now overheat while firing and cool back down after a short duration. If you keep firing while the guns are overheated, you run the risk of jamming them, effectively rendering them useless for several precious seconds.

The game is now fully playable with mouse alone, if the middle button is assigned to "select enemy in front". The keyboard is still needed to scroll and sort the list of all contacts and to select the nearest enemy. The default keyboard&mouse configuration has been updated to this control layout.

Your ship's cockpit has received several improvements. Its position inside the ship has been tweaked to improve visibility. The tactical radar display has been removed. Its functionality has been merged into the navigation radar, whose surface has also increased by almost 50%.

Other, smaller improvements include tweaks to missile guidance and enemy fighters' AI, several other cockpit visual fixes and improvements and many more.

Looking forward to your thoughts on these changes
Fly safe and good hunting

notes.title: Release Version Live ! Let the Music Play !
notes.notes:
Thrust&Shoot: Flight School will soon be leaving Early Access. It's been a ride ! Thanks to everyone who took a chance on an unfinished, unpolished, buggy game and helped me bring it to its current state.

The game's price has also increased to its final level. I will officially remove it from Early Access as soon as the final preparations are completed.

As for this version, the biggest improvement are music tracks which play during high-intensity moments. There are also a number of other, small tweaks and fixes, both technical and balance-wise.

Have fun and Good Hunting

notes.title: Version EA.9 Live !
notes.notes:
Greetings pilots

Version EA.9 brings a rework of the first mission, Obstacle Course. The track now takes you around and between asteroids, it has been extended both length- and time-wise and you'll find a couple of enemy bases that you have to level as quickly as possible. Additionally, version EA.9 includes updates and improvements to the other missions.

From now on, development will focus on adding joystick and controller support, controls, options, settings and final polish for release. If all goes well, the game will leave Early Access in the first quarter of 2018.

Good luck and good hunting

notes.title: Version EA.06 now live !
notes.notes:
All pilots, be advised

Thrust&Shoot version EA.06 is now live and ready.

The primary change is the ship's cockpit which now features not just one, but TWO radar displays ! One shows every object you've detected in relation to your ship, the other displays position, relative velocity and firing solution for your current selection. The previous radar was almost unusable when there were multiple objects nearby. After trying out several types of 3d displays, this is the best solution I've arrived at. Let me know what you think about it.

Other changes include regrouping the cockpit instruments for a cleaner look as well as several graphical and gameplay updates and bug fixes.

The plan for the next version is the addition of a new mission. More details to come.

Thanks for reading and good hunting !
The dev

notes.title: Version EA.05 Live !
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow pilots ! Here's what's new:

Assault map has been completely reworked: kill enemy turrets that are guarding a giant ring of floating rock. Take out power generators to disable turrets, take advantage of the ring itself to take cover.. and blast those batteries to space dust !

Additionally, a smaller rework of the Basic Flight map improves both gameplay and performance.

Last but not least, various tweaks, fixes and improvements throughout the game.

The next update will be focused on gameplay changes and improvements: I'm planning a major overhaul to the game's interface, cockpit displays and more !

Thanks for reading and good hunting !
The dev

notes.title: Version EA.04 Live
notes.notes:
Attention all pilots, version EA.04 is freshly live, ready for you to try out.

This update contains the game's intended progression system. After completing Basic Flight (the tutorial), you can fly the missions. However, you must earn at least the Bronze Medal in a mission (the lowest medal) in order to unlock the next mission.

There are four medals available: Bronze, Silver, Gold and Ace. They are progressively more difficult to earn. You can always replay any mission and try to earn a higher medal. How many can you Ace ?

The game saves your progression to the Steam Cloud, so you can change computers without losing your current progression and medals earned.

Other features of note are Steam Achievements and the Credits section, giving credit to all the creators whose work is included in the game.

The following update will focus more on gameplay. More details soon(-ish).

Thanks for reading and good hunting !
The dev

notes.title: Version EA.03 Live Now
notes.notes:
All pilots, be advised: the next version of the game is live and awaiting your feedback.

You'll find major improvements to the game's visuals: projectiles, muzzle flashes, explosions, damage effects as well as the overall visual feel and aspect.

Also starring, a gameplay fix for the Assault mission: enemy turrets now fire short, concentrated bursts which are somewhat easier to dodge, but also more deadly if you do get hit.

And of course, a number of other, smaller improvements that you'll have the pleasure to find in-game.

Good hunting !

PS: for the next update, besides bug squashing and gameplay tweaks, the big planned feature is Career Persistence. Medals that you earn in missions will become permanent and control your progression. Expect more info as the update nears deployment, most likely during early September 2017.

Thanks for your time
The dev
